answer: The timber assignment is published and ledge records each panel. The grading quorum of 9 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an adversary cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Shards are assigned from the ridge graph, so that cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 621 identities would post 4569 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
